entities.summary: Jeff Tambellini is a Canadian former professional ice hockey winger and current Assistant General Manager and Director of Hockey Operations for Tampa Bay Lightning of the NHL. Originally selected 27th overall by the Los Angeles Kings in the 2003 NHL entry draft, he joined the National Hockey League in 2005. During his rookie season, he was traded to the New York Islanders. He split his first three professional seasons between the NHL and his clubs' American Hockey League (AHL) affiliates, the Manchester Monarchs and Bridgeport Sound Tigers.
